cases.label: eval-fn-arrow-eval
cases.source: var g = this; var f = eval("(function(){ return (() => eval(\"this\"))(); })"); var r = f(); if (r !== g) throw new Error("arrow eval this in eval function: " + typeof r);

cases.label: eval-method-arrow-eval
cases.source: var g = this; var o = eval("({ m() { return (() => eval(\"this\"))(); } })"); var m = o.m; if (m() !== g) throw new Error("detached method"); if (o.m() !== o) throw new Error("method receiver");

cases.label: function-ctor-arrow-eval
cases.source: var g = this; var f = Function("return (() => eval(\"this\"))();"); if (f() !== g) throw new Error("Function constructor arrow eval this");

cases.label: primitive-receiver-nested-arrow-eval
cases.source: var f = eval("(function(){ return (() => () => eval(\"this\"))()(); })"); var p = f.call(5); if (typeof p !== "object" || p.valueOf() !== 5) throw new Error("primitive receiver: " + typeof p);

cases.label: parameter-arrow-eval
cases.source: var g = this; var f = eval("(function(h = () => eval(\"this\")){ return h(); })"); if (f() !== g) throw new Error("parameter arrow eval this");

cases.label: arrow-parameter-eval
cases.source: var g = this; var f = eval("(function(){ return ((a = eval(\"this\")) => a)(); })"); if (f() !== g) throw new Error("arrow parameter eval this");

cases.label: super-arrow-eval-primitive
cases.source: var o = eval("({ __proto__: { get x() { return this; } }, m() { return (() => eval(\"super.x\"))(); } })"); var r = o.m.call(5); if (typeof r !== "object" || r.valueOf() !== 5) throw new Error("super getter receiver: " + typeof r);
